title: BuyerTaxonomyPropertyValue
description: A property value for a specific product property, which may also employ a specific scale.

value_id.description: The numeric ID of this property value.

name.description: The name string of this property value.

scale_id.description: The numeric scale ID of the scale to which this property value belongs.

equal_to.description: A list of numeric property value IDs this property value is equal to (if any).
